lib/levanter/src/levanter/checkpoint.py.assessment: ResolvedCheckpoint and resolve_checkpoint live in the existing checkpoint ownership layer and have two actual maintained callers. The small frozen record expresses path plus optional stored metadata without fabricated discovery bookkeeping. The helper removes identical resolution logic and preserves failure semantics.

lib/levanter/src/levanter/layers/scan_ch.assessment: The descriptive from_spec name improves the maintained native scan policy API while preserving its full implementation and supported shorthand semantics. This is not a research artifact or an adapter layer.

lib/levanter/src/levanter/layers/stacked.assessment: Updates the real native policy caller consistently with the rename, preserving array stacking, rematerialization, forward and gradient behavior.

lib/levanter/src/levanter/main/export_lm.assessment: The existing public native exporter now consumes the shared resolved path/metadata pair and retains source semantic validation, full vocabulary, custom subtree and bounded writer policies. No independent export framework is added.

lib/levanter/src/levanter/model_loading..assessment: The shared native model loader uses the same resolver while retaining native-only semantic/placement checks and the named loader branch. This is ongoing loader reuse rather than a one-off historical helper.

contract_checks.assessment: The extracted resolver preserves the two prior algorithms: use the last numerically sorted complete candidate; otherwise read present direct metadata; otherwise retain the original concrete path with empty metadata. Invalid direct timestamp/step does not erase model metadata. Malformed JSON or unreadable direct metadata reaches uncaught _load_metadata after candidate discovery and propagates. Existing candidate ordering and run-directory skip behavior remain unchanged.

contract_checks.contract: Native semantic validation, full vocabulary and placement
contract_checks.assessment: Both callers feed resolved.metadata to the existing checkpoint_vocab_size validator. The loader retains tokenizer upper-bound checks, recovered source vocabulary and explicit placement validation. The exporter still restores complete metadata vocabulary before resizing. Resolved path selection is the only extracted policy; no source semantics are moved into checkpoint.py.

Native load_model retains its model subtree and exporter retains config.checkpoint_subpath. Named loader and exporter discovery, tokenizer, mesh, writer and dtype paths are untouched. No new subpath API or compatibility shim is introduced.

from_spec has exactly the prior _mk implementation. Repository search finds the native ArrayStacked caller updated; no native _mk caller remains. OLMo3 imports the distinct Haliax policy, whose established _mk and Haliax callers correctly remain unchanged. There is no numerical, rematerialization, configuration-wire or JIT behavior change.

Tests/docs are unchanged in this response. Existing real export/model-load semantic and metadata-free cases and ArrayStacked unrolled value/gradient oracles remain applicable. No guard-only test, internal mock, tolerance weakening or new framework is added. The two-field result record avoids inventing candidate step/timestamp for direct metadata-free restores.
